name: STREET SMG
_note: The only auto weapon: HOLD LMB. Bloom is the whole design. At 11.1 rounds/s a held trigger adds 0.0999 rad/s against a 0.075 rad/s recovery, so continuous fire walks the cone from 0.008 to the 0.055 cap in about 2 s and the crosshair opens the entire way — spray is loud, cheap and blind. A 3-round tap adds 0.027 and bleeds it back off in 0.36 s, so tapping stays surgical. 7 damage a round: 9 close rounds cripple a cruiser, 4 put an officer down (vs the pistol's 2).
_retail: Varsity Sports + Ammo (naming bible S7) sells the legal one. This is not it.
